name: RC-B10-0143/2026 – After § 12 – Am 10
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on four years of Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine and European contributions to a just peace and sustained security for Ukraine
part_text: 12a. Stresses that the unprecedented reconstruction needs resulting from Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine will require large-scale demolition, debris removal and the rehabilitation of buildings, many of which were constructed using hazardous materials, including asbestos, thereby exposing construction workers, emergency personnel and local communities to significant occupational and environmental health risks; underlines that insufficient monitoring, shortages of trained specialists and limited access to adequate protective equipment may increase the risk of long-term occupational diseases among workers involved in reconstruction activities;
